name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
steps: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with your shoulders back and core braced.
Step forward and bend both knees, bringing your rear knee toward the floor with the front foot flat.
Push through your front foot to stand up and smoothly step your rear foot forward into the next lunge.
Continue alternating legs with each step while maintaining an upright torso and steady rhythm.
tips: Keep your feet about hip-width apart from side to side as you step.
Keep your front knee aligned over your toes and avoid letting your torso slump forward.
